prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night just after rain on a 1930s city street: wet cobbles, an iron street lamp, a small red moon, a shop window full of loaves under a plain blank sign, its door open and glowing warm. Close on a tall thin police officer in a 1930s peaked cap and long blue coat with a grey walrus moustache, his real-skinned face large in frame and off-centre left, eyes closed in contentment, taking a big bite from the end of a fat warm loaf, crumbs in his moustache, his other hand touching the peak of his cap. Behind him, soft, the warm shop doorway and a faint emerald glow rising from a pavement grating. Most of the frame in shadow; the brightest values are the warm light on his face and the loaf. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
